conf.description: Oracle Database Audit, unified-audit-syslog, windows-event: same KEY:"value" body as the syslog-kv branch, plus the Windows envelope (Provider Name, TimeCreated, Computer, Level, EventID, EventRecordID) - lands in the same logs-oracle.unified_audit_syslog stream per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: unified-audit-syslog / windows-event (Windows branch of the syslog pipeline, same body grammar). 'Provider Name' has a space and cannot be a rename/eval.add target - read via bracket access in eval, deleted with code. Message body field is assumed to be named 'Message' (the conventional Windows-event-collector rendered-text field) - the work order does not name it explicitly; flagged as an assumption in README. Level maps to log.level as the raw Information/Warning/Error string mapped to the ECS vocabulary; event.outcome comes from RETCODE in the body, never from Level, per the work order's own note. TYPE/ACTION numeric-code lookups are the same unsupplied gap as the syslog-kv branch.

functions.description: TimeCreated (ISO 8601, timezone-qualified) becomes _time since @timestamp cannot be a target; 'Provider Name' (space in the source key) is read with bracket access per the awkward-field-name recipe; Level's Information/Warning/Error is mapped to the ECS log.level vocabulary

remove the envelope originals now materialized as event.provider/log.level/_time - 'Provider Name' cannot go through rename/eval.remove because of its space, so code deletes all three consumed envelope fields together
batch rename the remaining clean-identifier envelope fields
same fixed-order KEY:"value" extraction as the syslog-kv branch, run against the rendered message body field instead of _raw - this is that pipeline's Windows branch, not a new parser
derive error.code/event.outcome from the raw RETCODE capture before it is renamed away
batch rename the remaining body-captured fields onto their ECS/custom targets, identical mapping to the syslog-kv branch
tag the same data stream dataset component as the UNIX syslog-kv branch (logs-oracle.unified_audit_syslog)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
